svg.title: Qwen research journey: from working deployment to a measured kernel interaction
svg.desc: Six illustrated H200 research stages, a good output throughput trajectory, rejected branches, a separate H100 lane and the remaining verification loop. Dated evidence reviewed 19 October 2026 at 06:14 UTC. The 2938.628 H200 peak is a single locally accepted observation; independent interaction repeat and official accuracy are unverified.

g.text: Make it work. Measure it. Improve it. Verify it.
TTFT ≤ 3,000 ms AND request mean ITL ≤ 20 ms
16 GPUs • selected milestones, not isolated causal effects
Slurm smoke test; later a separate PBS cluster.
Pin model, containers, protocol and output checks.
Fix startup races, offline paths and port conflicts.
60 s warmup → 120 s scoring → 30 s grace
17 named trials: failures are not valid scores.
Request-scoped NIXL enables TP4 → TP8 KV.
Prefill and decode have different batch shapes.
Independent repeat supports the H200 gain.
Prefill token budget; the prompt stays ~4k.
N58 · job 24724 · +5.69% vs fresh N58 control
One accepted deployment; own repeat pending.
Official accuracy and global optimum unverified.
What the measured progression looks like
+53.67% from the early baseline; settings and loads differ. This is research progression, not a cumulative causal ablation.
Latest matched N58 change: mean ITL 16.498 → 14.998 ms; TTFT 784.526 → 871.991 ms; joint success 98.907%.
Faster repeated decode intervals can offset slower first-token arrival. This is a plausible explanation, not a profiled causal proof.
Branches that taught us where to stop
Failure, invalid output and slower performance have different meanings
PBS • 16 GPUs • no pooled H100/H200 ranking
H200 DeepGEMM gains did not transfer reliably.
Faster weight loading did not prove goodput gain.
N54 · job 221590 · best observed, own repeat pending
Ring all-reduce appears in sealed GPU traces.
N54 repeat → N56 → prefill NCCL Tree trial.
Prove actual Tree activation before crediting it.
What makes the next improvement credible
Planned / pending at the evidence cutoff; not new measurements
Promote only if the gain survives local gates.
Freeze model, payloads, scripts and runtime.
Run the organiser harness and reference tasks.
3 Profile, then choose the next target
Profile the actual winning H200 combination.
Close losing branches; avoid blind larger sweeps.
Preserve raw logs + failed runs + frozen configs + checksums + controls + credit ledger + dated decisions.
Arrows = research progression. N = active requests. All throughput figures = good output tokens/s.
Sources: REPORT.md, evidence.json and the linked run reviews. Snapshot only; no live queue status, official accuracy or global-optimum claim.
